description: Cancel an in-review submission (if still possible). Operates on the reviewSubmissions resource created by apple_submit_for_review — sets attributes.canceled=true via PATCH. The legacy appStoreVersionSubmissions DELETE endpoint only applied to submissions created through the retired create-submission flow and does not accept reviewSubmissions IDs.

submissionId.description: Review Submission ID (the ID returned by apple_submit_for_review)

name: apple_cancel_submission
